# Bitvavo.Net

> Strongly typed .NET client library for the Bitvavo spot REST and WebSocket APIs. Built on CryptoExchange.Net, with Shared API abstractions for exchange-agnostic code.

Bitvavo.Net provides typed REST and WebSocket clients, automatic WebSocket reconnection, client-side rate limiting that follows Bitvavo's two weight budgets, dependency injection, and the standard CryptoExchange.Net result model. REST calls return `HttpResult<T>`, WebSocket subscriptions return `WebSocketResult<UpdateSubscription>`. Package id: `Bitvavo.Net`. Repository version: 0.5.0 (pre-1.0). Targets net8.0, net9.0, net10.0. Bitvavo is spot only: no futures, no margin, no testnet.

## Critical Usage Rules

- Use `BitvavoRestClient` for REST and `BitvavoSocketClient` for WebSocket. With DI: `services.AddBitvavo(...)` (namespace `Bitvavo.Net.Extensions`), then inject `IBitvavoRestClient` and `IBitvavoSocketClient`.
- Never call Bitvavo with raw `HttpClient` or `ClientWebSocket`.
- Install with `dotnet add package Bitvavo.Net --prerelease` (pre-1.0, as in the README).
- Credentials: `new BitvavoCredentials(apiKey, apiSecret)` on the `ApiCredentials` option. Never hardcode or commit keys.
- REST surface: `restClient.SpotApi.{ExchangeData, Account, Trading, Funding, Report, Institutional}`. Socket surface: `socketClient.SpotApi.{ExchangeData, Account}`. Shared API: `SpotApi.SharedApi`.
- Always check `.Success` before reading `.Data`. `.Error.ErrorType` is the mapped CryptoExchange.Net `ErrorType` (90 Bitvavo error codes are mapped).
- Markets are `BASE-QUOTE`, uppercase, dash: `ETH-EUR`.
- Every order operation needs an operator id (`long`). A `clientOrderId` must be a UUID.
- Only `BitvavoEnvironment.Live` exists. No testnet, no validate-only order flag: every order call is live.
- Error 109 (`ErrorType.Timeout`, not transient): the operation may have happened. Read the order back before retrying.
- A WebSocket subscribe counts as successful once it is sent. Bitvavo sends no per-subscription acknowledgment.
- Public WebSocket streams: candles and trades. Private `account` channel: order and fill events, subscribed per market.
- Rate limiting: one static, settable limiter per process, `BitvavoExchange.RateLimiter` (namespace `Bitvavo.Net.Objects.Internal`). Two budgets of 1000 weight per minute: signed requests and public requests.
- Shared API: `IBitvavoSharedApiClient` offers `GetCapability<T>()`, `GetCapabilities<T>()` and `Discover()` over both transports. Bitvavo specifics travel as exchange parameters: `OperatorId` (`long`), `Markets` (`string[]`), optional `TriggerReference`.
- `AddBitvavo(o => o.ApiCredentials = ...)` with an untyped lambda configures only the REST client at language version C# 13 or later (the default of net9.0+ projects; at C# 12, the net8.0 default, the library-options overload is picked). Use `(BitvavoOptions o) => ...` or configuration to configure both clients at every language version.
- Never invent member names. The public surface is `Bitvavo.Net/Interfaces/Clients/`.

## Not implemented

- Public WebSocket ticker, ticker24h and book channels
- Local order book (`SymbolOrderBook`) and trackers
- Multi-user client provider
- WebSocket request/response actions
- Balance subscription (Bitvavo has no balance event)
- Batch orders (Bitvavo has no endpoint)
- Futures, margin, testnet (Bitvavo is spot only)

## Contributing rules

- TDD: failing test first. 0 warnings and 0 errors on net8.0, net9.0, net10.0.
- Always braces on control flow. No static Helper/Util classes (use extension methods or generics). No tuples (use `readonly record struct`).
- XML docs on public members. English only. One version number: `<Version>` in `Bitvavo.Net/Bitvavo.Net.csproj`.
- Extend the Shared API with one partial file per capability (see AGENTS.md).
- Build: `dotnet build Bitvavo.Net.slnx`. Test: `dotnet run --project Bitvavo.Net.Tests -f net10.0` (xunit v3 executable; `dotnet test` runs 0 tests on SDK 10).
